pages.text: $(l)Purpose$()$pBuilds configured devices and upgrades from exact combinations of analysed circuit boards.$p$(l)Set up and operate$()$p1. Use the recipe card to identify board numbers and state requirements.$p2. Analyse required boards before insertion.$p3. Provide FE and keep the finished-device output free.$p$(l)When it does not run$()$pA board with the right number but no analysed state cannot satisfy an analysed ingredient.$pRead the active server settings below before copying default costs from another installation. For special slot roles, use the machine screen labels. Settings reporting does not inspect or mutate a placed machine.$pActual server settings: live server values are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$pProcessing / value recipes: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$pCrafting / obtaining this machine: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$p$(l:foundations_calculator:troubleshooting/no_progress)General operating checklist$()
